asset.name: Bittensor

score_rationales.supply: TAO has a fixed 21M max supply with supply-milestone halvings (first halving at 10.5M issued cuts the block reward from 1 to 0.5 TAO and halves schedule issuance per docs.learnbittensor.org and Staking Rewards’ Bittensor methodology). CoinGlass currently reports circulating supply near 10.78M TAO (~51% of max), while Tao Yield and Staking Rewards–style dashboards cite roughly 67–76% of supply staked—materially reducing liquid float despite ongoing emissions. A single authoritative, cited time series for aggregate exchange balances was not available in this pass, so reserve direction is not scored as bullish; the grade leans on hard cap, halving-driven disinflation, and very high staking lock-up.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: As of early 2026 the network runs at the 128 active-subnet cap with post–Dynamic TAO expansion from tens of subnets to a full competitive grid, Taostats remains the official on-chain analytics surface since 2022, and third-party summaries cite roughly $1.1B aggregate subnet alpha market cap—clear breadth of specialized deployments and staking-driven compute markets, offset by heterogeneous subnet quality and emission-heavy incentives that keep usage signals noisy versus traditional TVL-style adoption.
score_rationales.value_capture: Subnet registration fees, compute marketplace fees

decision_trace.summary: Observe: research/watchlist state only; no active accumulation signal.
